thanks Oliv, and glad you like it Kimbruun!

Equally ridiculous is the offspring from this clone. I've crossed it with other hurricane creek whites, and some of the seedlings are turning out to be potentially even more stunning than the parents. Only time will tell!

Here's hurricane creek white clone F x clone D:
